verdicts.reason: req.url is joined, normalized, and rejected with 403 unless the result still starts with ADMIN_PATH; '..' escapes are blocked, leaving only a same-prefix sibling-directory edge that the shown layout does not make reachable.
io_utils.pickle_load unpickles label_quantiles.pkl straight from the model directory; Rasa models are loadable from user-supplied or remote archives and nothing verifies the file first.
Table name goes through __filter_str and values are bound (:key); the only interpolated part is data.keys(), column names fixed by the calling code rather than by request data.
This is DOMPurify's own KEEP_CONTENT step: innerHTML of a rejected node is re-inserted into the inert working document, where the node iterator sanitizes the inserted children afterwards.
relative_path in get_cache_path is supplied by cornac's own dataset loaders or derived from library-defined dataset URLs; no external input reaches the join.
$admin is the integer flag of getNbOfUsers($limitTo,$option,$admin=-1), guarded by $admin >= 0 and passed as a literal by internal callers, not from the request.
extractStreamed is a protected helper whose docblock states entry paths were validated in the caller's pre-pass before the fopen($target) write; no unvalidated path is shown reaching it.
Command templates come from the Glances config file and stat values pass through _sanitize_mustache_dict before chevron.render; execution is via secure_popen, not a shell.
createSchemaCommand is built from this.dbOpts (server database config) and targetSchema wrapped by quotePgIdentifier; no request-controlled value is shown reaching run().
checkServerTrusted is an empty method in a public 'default implementation' trust manager shipped in the client library, so any connection configured with it accepts every certificate chain.
delete(name) only rejects the TMP_EXT suffix, then path.join(this._root, name) is passed to fs.rimraf; unlike add(), no requireValidItemOptions/basename check constrains the client-supplied name.
$ldap_mobile, an attribute read from the LDAP directory (often user-editable), is concatenated into value="..." with no dol_escape_htmltag, unlike other fields on the page.

SSLIgnoreAdapter is an explicitly documented opt-out adapter ('should only be used when absolutely necessary') that is mounted only when the operator disables ssl_verify; CERT_NONE here is the intended configured behaviour.
print $ldap_skype emits a directory-sourced attribute into the page body with no HTML escaping.
e.innerHTML = e.innerHTML + ' ' re-assigns the element's existing markup plus a constant; no new untrusted data is introduced.
$object->getLibStatut(4) returns a translated status label with a picto derived from the integer status, not user-supplied text.
exportPath is os.tmpdir() plus a fixed prefix and the first 8 characters of the id of a session already loaded from the store (the session object is exported), so the name is a generated id fragment.

isDir joins a template-supplied path to p.repoDir and stats it with no isSubdirectory check, while the sibling readFile does enforce containment; repository-controlled templates can probe paths outside the repo.
add_limit_offset! interpolates options[:offset] raw into the SQL (" OFFSET #{offset}") with no integer coercion, and applications routinely pass request params as :offset.
The String.format at this line only substitutes tempTableName and tempBoundsTableName, server-generated temp table identifiers; attribute filtering is done via the temp table join.
Config-defined command templates are rendered with values run through _sanitize_mustache_dict and executed by secure_popen rather than a shell.
The plain-CSV query formats in only the two server-generated temp table names; no request value is interpolated.
print $ldap_login writes a directory-sourced value into the HTML body unescaped, whereas the adjacent GETPOST('login') branch uses dol_escape_htmltag.
The interpolated value is $thirdparty_seller->country_code, a country dictionary code loaded from the database for the seller record, not request input.

Column names are inserted as [${col}] and item.updateKey as a bare identifier in the UPDATE text; only values are bound, so workflow/expression-derived column names or keys can alter the statement (escapeTableName is applied to the table only).
delete_checkpoint builds checkpoints_path / f"{checkpoint_id}.json" and unlinks it with no validation of checkpoint_id, so '../' sequences delete .json files outside the checkpoints directory.
_unpack_pos_dict calls pickle.loads on gzip-decompressed bytes taken from a lemmatizer model file; a downloaded or third-party model can execute code on load.
execSync(`git show :2:"${file}"`) runs through a shell with the conflicted file name only wrapped in double quotes, so $(...) or a quote in the name injects commands.
Only tempTableName and tempBoundsTableName (server-generated) are formatted into this inner query.
input_path comes from module params and is opened after only a '..' substring check, which does not stop absolute paths; arbitrary files can be read.
readFile panics unless isSubdirectory(p.repoDir, path) holds before the join and os.ReadFile.
getDefinitionSQL is a schema-introspection helper whose tableName/schemaName come from the datasource's own table listing during buildSchema, not from request data.
rasa.utils.io.pickle_load reads <metadata>.meta.pkl from the model directory; a crafted model archive executes code when the policy loads.
encode_io sends the stream on stdin; the only interpolated values are the developer-supplied ffmpeg options string, which the API documents as raw options, and a numeric volume filter.
receiver_socket.recv_pyobj() unpickles whatever arrives on the ZeroMQ socket from the remote process, with no authentication or validation shown.
sfile is checked with is_safe_path(src, sfile, fil) and the handler returns 'Path Traversal Detected!' before any open().

This is the Vite dev-server middleware: the URL-derived path is resolved and only served if it is an existing file allowed by server.fs.allow, then handed to the static middleware; development tooling, not a deployed sink.
This is the implementation of jQuery's .html() setter, an API whose purpose is to assign caller-provided HTML; the caller decides what value to pass.
w.Write emits model.MapToJson(responseData), a JSON-encoded body, not HTML markup built from the request.
execAsync(`net user "${username}"`) puts the tool-supplied username into a shell string with only double quotes around it and no validation.
statSync is called on the same generated tmpdir export path (fixed prefix plus 8 characters of an existing session id).
execAsync(`id -Gn "${username}"`) interpolates the tool-supplied username into a shell command; $(...) or a quote breaks out.
The marked path.join only runs when common.isTempFile(filename) accepts the name, so the joined value is restricted to generated temp-file names.
pathname reaching fs.readFile was normalized and rejected unless it starts with ADMIN_PATH (or was replaced by the fixed index.html fallback).
openSaveFile passes the file name announced by the remote trzsz peer to getUniqueFilePath, which does path.join(dir, fileName) with no basename or containment check before the FileWriter writes it.
backup_name in this local backup CLI is a generated name or one chosen by the invoking user; there is no separate attacker supplying it.
LocalStorage.download reads self.root / backup_name where the name is chosen by the local CLI user from their own backups.

The call suppresses InsecureRequestWarning for the requests.post to the version-check endpoint a few lines below, which is sent unconditionally with verify=False; certificate verification is disabled for that request.
$order passes through fixOrder(), $amount is formatted with %d, and the content type slug comes from the site's content type configuration.
joblib.load is applied to every *.pkl found under the model directory, so a malicious model archive runs code when loaded.
innerHTML receives editMode.lang.exitFullscreen/viewFullscreen, developer-configured language strings, not end-user data.
This path.join only builds strings for the session-complete status message; no file operation uses savedFilePaths.
shadow_id must match _SHADOW_ID_RE and format must be 'html' or 'pdf' before the path is built.
Dev-server-only middleware: the decoded path is only probed with existsSync and then the request is delegated to the asset server rooted at files.assets.
The HQL entity name is bclass.getName() for a class with custom mapping enabled, a privileged schema-level setting; the object id is bound as :id.

The only request-derived part is $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']; $object->id and $group->id are integers, and Dolibarr's main include rejects requests whose PHP_SELF contains quote characters, so the attribute cannot be broken out of.
module_checkout_path is osp.join(repo.working_tree_dir, path) with the submodule path taken from caller/.gitmodules data and passed to clone_from with no containment check.
execSync runs `git -C "${folderPath}" branch -r --list "origin/${branchName}"` through a shell; both values are only double-quoted, so command substitution in tool input or a branch name executes.
pri_key_value, derived from the WebDAV request path, is concatenated inside quotes into the SELECT with no escaping or bind parameter.
safe_extract checks every member with is_within_directory (abspath prefix plus os.sep) and passes members=safe_paths(tar) before extractall.
The opened file is UPLD_DIR/<md5_hash>/classdump.txt with a constant filename, after form validation of the hash.
In the numeric branch pri_key_value from the request path is appended unquoted to the SQL string and executed.
md5 is used only after viewsource_form.is_valid(), and the final file path is checked by is_safe_path.
Same pattern as the INSERT helper: filtered table name, bound values, and column names taken from the calling code's data dict keys.
admin_role_actions interpolates the filter argument directly into an Arel.sql LIKE fragment (#{filter}) with no quoting or allowlist.
hugo import jekyll is a local CLI run by the site owner; relPath comes from walking the user's own Jekyll directory.
delete_backup's name is chosen by the local user of this personal backup CLI.

Writes go to MAIN_DIR . $_POST['file'] behind the editor's authentication and 'editfile' permission, and the nested guard block that closes just before the switch is the request-parameter path check; note the guard's body lies above the excerpt.
The href contains only $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] and the integer $object->id; Dolibarr's main include rejects PHP_SELF values containing quotes.
options[:limit] is interpolated raw (" LIMIT #{limit}") with no integer coercion, and callers commonly pass request parameters.
stmt contains the user-supplied raw SQL query expression substituted into the subscriber query; a read-only transaction does not stop it reading arbitrary data.
Remove(name) takes the extension name from the local user's own gh command line and normalizes it; there is no separate attacker.
The query embeds $thirdparty_seller->country_code, a dictionary country code loaded from the database, not request input.
getAutoColumnsSQL is called with table names enumerated from the datasource itself during schema build.
docs/demo code that renders the visitor's own markdown output into a preview iframe; demo page, not library code.
Rendered values are sanitized by _sanitize_mustache_dict and the config-defined command is run by secure_popen with an explicit operator policy.
queryExp, the caller-supplied raw SQL expression, is substituted into QuerySubscribersCount via strings.ReplaceAll and executed; the read-only transaction is not sanitization.
The symlink target is produced by ensureLinkPath(dirPath, dirName, filePath, header.Linkname), which validates it before os.Symlink; this line just retries after removing the old link.
getFullName() returns the stored donor first/last name and it is printed into a table cell with no dol_escape_htmltag.
column_list is supplied by the library's internal callers as fixed column names and the table name is filtered.
execAsync(`sc query "${serviceName}"`) places the tool-supplied service name in a shell command with only double quotes.
$path is wrapped in escapeshellarg and $action is an internal 'install'/'update' keyword passed by console commands.
pri_key_value from the WebDAV path is concatenated unquoted into the SELECT in the numeric branch.
serviceName is interpolated completely unquoted into the `systemctl list-dependencies` shell command.
The cleaned join is only used if pathContainedIn(raw, loneRoot) holds, and the alternative path is likewise checked against root.
Same local CLI delete_backup as the script variant; the name is chosen by the invoking user.
element.innerHTML receives the output of the HTMLSanitizer (new this(html, options).sanitize()), not the raw input.
folderPath is embedded in an execSync shell string inside double quotes only, so command substitution in the supplied path executes.
$ldap_skype from the LDAP directory is concatenated into value="..." without escaping; a quote in the attribute breaks out of it.
Only $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] and the integer $object->id are placed in the href; Dolibarr's main include rejects PHP_SELF values containing quotes.
pickle.loads decodes bytes that vLLM's own writer process serialized into its shared-memory ring buffer; this is internal IPC, not externally supplied data.
execAsync(`net user "${username}"`) builds a shell command from the tool-supplied username with no validation.
The executed SQL embeds only the seller's dictionary country code loaded from the database.
The ogr2ogr options, which include names derived from the uploaded files and original_name, are joined into one string and run with Popen(shell=True) without quoting.
toCompleteStatement only prefixes a short-form statement with the select clause; it executes nothing and is not a sink.
$admin is the integer filter parameter (default -1) passed as a literal by internal callers.
_serve serves any path for which File.readable? is true, with the path taken from the HTTP request and no containment to a document root.
The executable filename comes from the gemspec of the gem being installed, which is already trusted code at install time.
getConstraintsSQL receives table names from the datasource's own schema listing.
The path is resolved and rejected with 400 unless is_path_inside(file_path, base_path) holds before FileResponse.
generate_bin_script joins bindir with an executable name taken from the gemspec of the gem being installed; gem installation is already a trusted-code operation and no request-level input reaches it.
file_path from module params only passes a "'..' in file_path" substring check, so an absolute path reaches os.makedirs/open unconstrained.
pri_key_value (second segment of the WebDAV request path via _split_path) and table_name are concatenated into the SELECT with quotes but no escaping.
itemUuid from the resources API is passed to path.join(this.resources[type].path, itemUuid) for readFile/stat with no validation or containment check.
execAsync(`docker inspect ${serviceName}`) interpolates the tool-supplied service name unquoted into a shell string.
$_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] (includes attacker-controlled PATH_INFO) is printed into the form action attribute with no dol_escape_htmltag or other encoding in the shown code.
The table name passes __filter_str and the column definition is a developer-supplied schema string from internal library callers, not request data.
"DESCRIBE " + table_name is executed with table_name taken from the request path by _split_path, with no quoting or validation.
backup_name in LocalStorage.download is chosen by the local CLI operator for their own configured storage root; no untrusted party supplies it.
scope[:group] is a developer-defined finder scope option documented as a raw SQL fragment, not end-user data at this layer.
table_name and pri_key_value from the WebDAV request path are concatenated straight into the SELECT executed by cursor.execute.
The key split here is the blob key generated in the same module as [tenant, secure_token].join('/'), so the joined components are server-generated.
The handler writes model.MapToJson output (JSON-encoded) with a redirect URI already checked by IsValidRedirectURL; it is not an HTML sink.
The cleaned join of root and rawPath is immediately rejected by pathContainedIn(abs, root) when it escapes the repo root.
mkdir(root, name) is a generic helper; nothing in the shown code feeds it untrusted input.
The group find option is a developer-supplied SQL fragment by framework contract; no user data source is shown.
The default name is the PHP-basenamed client filename and targetPath/name are developer-supplied arguments to move(); no traversal-capable input is shown.
uid must first resolve to a successful Sketchfab API download, and the zip is written as uid.zip inside a fresh mkdtemp directory; not a realistic traversal.
username is interpolated into `getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:"` run through exec; double quotes do not stop $() or quote breakout.
convert() is a developer-run conversion script that torch.loads a checkpoint path given on the local command line; tooling-only.
pri_key_value from the request path is concatenated inside single quotes into the SELECT without escaping.
limited_update_conditions only wraps already-quoted identifiers and a where_sql built by the framework's sanitized condition builder.
Filesystem::link receives developer-supplied paths (e.g. storage:link); no user input reaches the mklink exec in the shown code.
joblib.load(path) is the library's explicit load-my-saved-model API on a caller-chosen local artifact; no untrusted source is shown.
output_path from module params is only checked for the substring '..', so an absolute path is opened for writing unconstrained.
pickle_load deserializes .pkl files from a Rasa model archive, which Rasa loads from remote storage/model servers without integrity checks.
$ldap_firstname from the external LDAP directory is printed into the page (and a value attribute) with no HTML escaping.
getFile is only reached through the minify handler in this file, which imports sanitizePathname to normalise the request path before resolving it under ROOT_DIR.
order is matched against fixed case branches and the interpolated locale/default_locale are the application's locale codes, not free-form request input.
merged_conditions comes from merge_conditions, which sanitizes each condition before it is appended after WHERE.
The verification-disabling adapter is an explicit operator opt-in (ssl_verify=false), not a default behaviour.
params['input_path'] from the workflow is passed straight to Image.open with no path restriction of any kind.
pickle.loads reads metadata from vLLM's own shared-memory buffer written by its trusted sibling processes, not an external channel.
sfile was validated by is_safe_path(src, sfile, fil) with an early error return before this read.
execSync(`git show :1:"${file}"`) puts a conflicted file name from the repository inside double quotes in a shell string, which still allows $() and quote breakout.
pickle_load of sparse_feature_sizes.pkl from the model directory deserializes files from a Rasa model archive that can come from remote/untrusted sources.
searchSpacesNames is a documented scripting API whose argument is by contract an HQL where clause, with values bound through parameterValues; no request data source is shown.
The io.open(sfile) for the xml type runs only after is_safe_path(src, sfile, fil) has passed.
backup_name in LocalStorage.upload is generated by the tool for the operator's own storage directory.
toCompleteStatement only prefixes a constant select clause to a short-form statement; it introduces no injection beyond the caller's statement.
Local preview server; the filename is only streamed after the is_file/prerendered checks on the build output.
The path is UPLD_DIR + md5_hash + constant 'classdump.txt', and the hash is validated as an MD5 in MobSF request handling.
pathname is normalised and rejected with 403 unless it startsWith(ADMIN_PATH) before the exists/stat/readFile calls.
The marked join is inside isSubdirectory itself, the containment check (filepath.Rel '..' test plus Lstat symlink test).
rid is passed through $this->db->escape and quoted, and entity is the caller/conf entity integer; no raw request data is shown reaching the query.
The hard-link target is validated by ensureLinkPath and resolved relative to the entry's directory before os.Link.
Only the table goes through escapeTableName; the workflow-supplied deleteKey is embedded as [${deleteKey}] with no bracket escaping in the DELETE statement.
The cleaned join of the indexer root and rawPath is rejected by pathContainedIn(abs, root) when it escapes.
JSON-encoded response with url.QueryEscape on code and state and a redirect URI validated earlier; not an HTML sink.
$ldap_fax from the LDAP directory is printed into the HTML page and a value attribute without escaping.
fullpath comes from tree entries of the checked-out (possibly attacker-supplied) repository and `${dir}/${fullpath}` is removed/written with no containment check.
tar.extractall(path=dest_dir) extracts a downloaded artifact archive with no member filter or path check.
sfile is validated with is_safe_path(lib_dir, sfile, relative_path) and checksum with is_md5 before the open.
Only locale[0..1] (two characters of the application locale code) is interpolated, which cannot carry an injection payload.
joblib.load deserializes a .joblib file from Rasa model storage, populated from model archives that may be remote/untrusted.
input_data from module params is opened as a file after only a '..' substring check, so absolute paths are readable.
The unverified context is used only when the operator has disabled options.verify_ssl_cert or answers 'y' at the explicit prompt.
Development-server existence probe only; serving is gated by Vite's fs.allow list and this is dev-only tooling.
The response is MapToJson output and redirectUri has passed IsValidRedirectURL; no HTML is emitted here.
The checkpoint name is formatted into f"{name}.json" under the checkpoints dir and opened with no sanitization or containment check.
Maintainer release tooling; base and since derive from local git refs and a strftime-formatted date.
The symlink target is validated by ensureLinkPath and filePath by resolveRelToBase before os.Symlink.
cur.execute(query, params) runs prepared put statements with bound parameters; no user data is shown in the query text.
locale passed to collation_for is the application's current locale code constrained to configured locales, not free-form input.

pickle_load of label_data.pkl deserializes files from a Rasa model archive that may come from remote or API-supplied locations.
